root_cause.text: `ipgre_header()` in the IPv4 GRE tunnel code assumed the skb always had enough headroom for `t->hlen + sizeof(struct iphdr)`, so when `dev->needed_headroom`/`hard_header_len` changed dynamically it could call `skb_push()` on an undersized skb and underflow/crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an explicit `skb_headroom(skb) < needed` check and calls `pskb_expand_head()` before `skb_push(skb, needed)`, and the CVE description says crashes happened when team/bonding changed `dev->needed_headroom`/`dev->hard_header_len` and `mld_newpack()` had allocated “a too small reserve/headroom” before an ipgre device was attached.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: `ipgre_header()` in the IPv4 GRE tunnel code assumed the skb always had enough headroom for `t->hlen + sizeof(struct iphdr)`, so when `dev->needed_headroom`/`hard_header_len` changed dynamically it could call `skb_push()` on an undersized skb and underflow/crash.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds an explicit `skb_headroom(skb) < needed` check and calls `pskb_expand_head()` before `skb_push(skb, needed)`, and the CVE description says crashes happened when team/bonding changed `dev->needed_headroom`/`dev->hard_header_len` and `mld_newpack()` had allocated “a too small reserve/headroom” before an ipgre device was attached.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure ipgre header construction expands skb headroom when needed instead of failing or writing past available space.
intent_record.what: The function now computes a local `needed` size equal to `t->hlen + sizeof(*iph)`, checks whether the skb has enough headroom for that amount, and if not attempts to grow the skb head with `pskb_expand_head()` using an aligned expansion size. If expansion fails, it returns `-needed`. The subsequent `skb_push()` call was changed to use the `needed` variable instead of recomputing the size inline.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the code can now safely prepend the GRE/IP header even when the packet buffer initially lacks sufficient headroom. This prevents header insertion from overrunning skb space and allows transmission to proceed by reallocating headroom when necessary; if that cannot be done, the function fails early with an error.

grouping_result.intent: Ensure ipgre header construction expands skb headroom when needed instead of failing or writing past available space.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it fixes ipgre header construction to handle insufficient skb headroom safely instead of assuming enough space for skb_push(), preventing underflow/crash when headroom requirements change.

candidates.rationale: This directly pushes the skb data pointer by the GRE/IP header size without any headroom check or expansion. If the skb headroom is smaller than the requested length, skb_push() can underflow and corrupt memory or crash, matching the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement advances the skb data pointer by the GRE/IP header length without verifying that the skb has sufficient headroom. If the available headroom is smaller than t->hlen + sizeof(*iph), skb_push() can underflow, which matches the described crash/corruption root cause.
